style.styleTitle: Lights4fun 2ft 4 Pre Lit Black Metal Micro LED Twig Tree
style.toneOfVoice: Have a Christmas full of sparkle with the 70cm Pre Lit Black Metal Micro LED Twig Tree. Set it up in your home for an uplifting shine as the days get shorter. The optional 6-hour timer can turn the lights on automatically every night and then off again to save you the work. There’s also a constant ‘on’ mode. The black metal micro LED twig tree shines with 300 micro-LEDs for an amazing contrast of dark and light. The warm white light has a twinkling effect to sparkle and amaze during winter nights. Let the warm white LEDs shine for a beautiful glowing aura during dark nights. Set yourself up for a special Christmas with the pre lit black metal twig tree, it’ll spread holiday cheer throughout your home for family and friends. Seize the day with the low maintenance twig tree. Treat it with care and it can come out year after year.
